name: Zerubbabel
summary: Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel led people back from captivity and became governor of Judah. With Jeshua the priest he began rebuilding the house of the LORD in Jerusalem, and the LORD promised that his hands would finish it.

key_moments.title: Laying the Foundation
key_moments.description: Zerubbabel and Jeshua set the Levites to lead the work on the house of the LORD in Jerusalem. When the foundation was laid, the priests blew trumpets and the whole crowd gave a great shout of praise to the LORD.

key_moments.title: Help Turned Away
key_moments.description: Enemies of the people came and asked to help build, saying they sought the same God. Zerubbabel and Jeshua told them they had no part in it, for the people would build it themselves as King Cyrus had commanded.

key_moments.title: Stirred Up to Build
key_moments.description: Zerubbabel, Joshua the high priest and all the rest obeyed what the LORD said through Haggai. The LORD stirred their spirits, and they set to work on His house.

key_moments.title: Not by Might
key_moments.description: The LORD told Zerubbabel the work would be done not by might or power, but by His spirit. Zerubbabel's hands had begun the house, and his hands would also finish it.
